admin.agent.description: Let agents operate this admin panel through Skills or MCP.
admin.agent.quickstart_hint: Issue a key for an agent in the Agents tab, then connect one of these ways.

admin.agent.skill_hint: Copy this prompt to your agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw…), then send it the key you issued under Agents. The agent saves each project's URL and key in a private local credentials file (readable only by you), never in a repository. For several projects, copy the prompt from this page on each site. Note: the key stays in the chat history — revoke it under Agents if it leaks or is no longer needed.
admin.agent.skill_prompt:
Please add "{app}" ({url}) as a project you can manage, under the project name "{name}".

1. If you don't have the site-admin skill yet, download these two files into a site-admin folder in your skills directory (e.g. ~/.claude/skills/site-admin/). If it's already installed, skip this step and don't overwrite it: the client can read every project's key, so update it only when I explicitly ask, from a site I trust.
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=SKILL.md → site-admin/SKILL.md
   - {url}/api/admin/agent/skill?file=admin-client.mjs → site-admin/scripts/admin-client.mjs
2. I'll send you this project's admin key (starts with sa_admin_) next. Save it via stdin — never as a command argument — and never repeat it afterwards:
   printf '%s' '<key>' | node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs add {name} {url}
3. Run node <skill-dir>/scripts/admin-client.mjs --project {name} list and tell me which operations you can call.
4. From then on, follow SKILL.md strictly for the admin tasks I give you; when managing several projects, name the project with --project on every call.
admin.agent.full_docs: Full reference (idempotency, audit, local stdio MCP bridge, CLI agent/key management): docs/admin-agent.md in the repository.
admin.agent.never_warning: A non-expiring key works until you revoke it. Give the agent minimal roles, and revoke the key as soon as it's no longer needed or may have leaked.
admin.agent.created_warning: Copy this key now — it won't be shown again. Store it in the agent's secret store, never in the repository.
admin.agent.revoke_warning: Revoke this key? Agents using it lose access immediately. This can't be undone.
admin.agent.accounts_hint: Each agent is an API-type user: its permissions are the RBAC roles you assign, and it signs in only with its admin API keys. Agents aren't counted as users.
admin.agent.agent_form_hint: Pick the roles this agent acts with. You can only grant roles whose permissions you hold yourself.
admin.agent.no_agents: No agents yet. Create one, assign roles, then issue a key.
admin.agent.keys_hint: Admin API keys (sa_admin_…) for this agent. Only a hash is stored; a key is shown once. They never work on the product API.
admin.agent.delete_warning: The agent account, its role assignments and all its keys are removed. Agents using them lose access immediately. Its execution history is kept.

landing.faq.description: Answers about text prompts, image conversion, SVG downloads, and your {brand} account.
landing.faq.stack.question: How do I generate an SVG with {brand}?
landing.faq.stack.answer: Choose Text to SVG and describe your idea, or choose Image to SVG and select an image. Generate or convert the artwork, review the result, and select Download SVG.
landing.faq.payment.question: Do I need credits to use {brand}?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Your first text or image preview does not need an account. Choose a paid plan to unlock the SVG file and make more artwork. AI generation settles to actual usage; image conversion uses 160 credits per SVG.
landing.faq.database.question: Which image formats can I convert?
landing.faq.database.answer: Choose a PNG, JPG, or WebP image up to 10 MB, subject to image dimension limits. {brand} converts supported images into editable SVG paths.
landing.faq.customize.question: How can I contact {brand} support?
landing.faq.customize.answer: Email support@aisvg-generator.com for help with generation, downloads, credits, billing, or your account. Never send your password or API keys.
landing.faq.license.question: Where can I use my downloaded SVG?
landing.faq.license.answer: Open it in a compatible vector editor or use it on a website, in a presentation, or in a design project. Review the output and make sure you have the rights needed for your intended use. See the Terms of Service for details.

Staff, service accounts and test browsers are excluded. Top 100 groups shown.

admin.operations.method_source: Adapted from the supplied Gefei operations notes: keep data in your database, compare matching hours, investigate the funnel and record each experiment. Case-study claims and screenshots are reference material, not this site’s results.
admin.operations.method_metrics: Revenue is grouped by the actual payment currency, in its correct minor units. It includes renewals in the daily totals and subtracts recorded refunds from the original paid orders; refunds therefore revise the original payment day. Cohort revenue excludes renewals. Completed tasks determine AI success rate; pending tasks are shown separately. A dash means no observations or no denominator.
admin.operations.method_experiments: The journal stores observations, hypotheses, changes, build versions and reviews. Sample targets are plans, not measured traffic. It does not allocate A/B traffic or estimate a winning probability. Define the product variants, exposure event and attribution window before enabling a live experiment.
admin.operations.method_tracking: Visitor collection starts after this feature is installed, honors cookie consent, Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control, and ignores known bots and private pages. Local development usually has no country header. Open a fresh test browser with ?ops_test=1 on its first visit to exclude that browser. Build IDs come from Git at build time; deployments may override VITE_BUILD_ID. Anonymous traffic is browser-based and cannot identify the same person across devices.
admin.operations.experiments_hint: Record the data, hypothesis and change before experimenting; save the evidence and outcome afterward. This journal does not change live traffic or pricing.
admin.operations.no_experiments_hint: Which step loses the most users? Record a specific observation, a testable hypothesis and the change you plan to make.
admin.operations.result_hint: Actual samples, revenue, dates and decision
admin.operations.review_hint: Insufficient evidence is a valid outcome. Record it explicitly; a completed review cannot be overwritten.

svgai.marketing.step_refine_text: Run the AI SVG generator and compare the color and outline previews. Inspect the icon, logo, or illustration at its intended size. Image conversion supports four, eight, or sixteen colors and removal of a connected solid background.
svgai.marketing.step_download_text: Choose a paid plan to unlock the SVG download and vector code. Open the editable file in a compatible vector editor, adjust the paths, or place the SVG in a website or design layout.
svgai.marketing.benefit_paths_descriptio: The SVG contains editable vector paths, rather than an embedded bitmap. Adjust the palette and scale the artwork without locking an icon or logo to one image resolution.

svgai.marketing.faq_description: Practical answers about the AI SVG generator, image conversion, and the files you take away.
svgai.marketing.faq_input_question: How do I create an SVG from text or an image?
svgai.marketing.faq_input_answer: Enter a text prompt or choose a PNG, JPG, or WebP image, then select Generate free preview. Text and image modes share one free preview without registration. A paid plan unlocks the editable SVG and vector code. Signing in links the saved preview to the account. Unlocking uses the displayed allowance once; repeated downloads of that SVG do not consume more credits.
svgai.marketing.faq_paths_question: Does converting an image to SVG make it infinitely detailed?
svgai.marketing.faq_paths_answer: No. The generator reconstructs visible shapes from the source image; missing image detail cannot be recovered. Flat illustrations, an icon, or a high-contrast logo usually trace more clearly than photographs. Inspect small vector paths, compare color settings, and simplify stray fragments. Review an icon at interface size and a logo at its intended display size. Complex artwork may need separate small and large SVG versions.
svgai.marketing.faq_formats_question: Which files can I upload and download?
svgai.marketing.faq_formats_answer: Upload a PNG, JPG, or WebP image up to 10 MB, subject to image dimension limits. The generator returns an editable SVG containing vector paths. Prefer a clear original image over a small screenshot. For a PNG copy, export the SVG from a compatible vector editor.
svgai.marketing.faq_privacy_question: Are my uploaded images sent to an AI provider?
svgai.marketing.faq_privacy_answer: Image conversion sends a resized image to a server-side vector converter, without sending the source image to an AI provider. Text generation sends the prompt to the AI provider. Saved generation records support recovery and billing. The original visitor session or linked account can access the preview; editable SVG source requires verified payment. The Privacy Policy explains processing and retention.
svgai.marketing.faq_tools_question: Can I use the SVG in design and cutting tools?
svgai.marketing.faq_tools_answer: SVG files work in compatible vector editors such as Figma, Illustrator, and Inkscape, and in modern browsers. Keep an original SVG and compare imported paths and colors with the preview. Cutting and embroidery tools may require closed contours, fewer overlaps, or specific strokes. Check the vector file before production. For websites, test icon and logo contrast and provide relevant alternative text.

svgai.seo.intro_one: The AI SVG generator turns text or an image into editable vector artwork. Describe a subject, palette, and style for an icon, logo concept, or illustration. Image conversion traces visible edges into SVG paths. Review a free preview before choosing a plan.
svgai.seo.intro_two: Compare color and outline views to inspect vector geometry. After unlocking, adjust vector colors or inspect the SVG code. An editable SVG moves between browsers, vector editors, and design layouts, without a proprietary file format.
svgai.seo.uses_title: Editable SVG for icon, logo, and illustration work.
svgai.seo.uses_icons_text: Generate interface icons with a shared palette and silhouette. Repeat the vector style across text prompts for a consistent icon set. Check every icon at its smallest display size, where simple vector geometry reads more clearly than fine image detail.
svgai.seo.uses_brand_text: An AI SVG generator can help explore an abstract logo, botanical emblem, or identity illustration. Compare vector directions and refine an editable logo in design software. Review originality, trademark conflicts, and usage rights before adopting a final logo.
svgai.seo.uses_print_title: Vector illustration for screen and print
svgai.seo.uses_print_text: Use editable SVG illustrations in posters, packaging, slides, and web layouts. Before professional production, confirm the required format, color setup, minimum stroke width, and finishing process. A scalable SVG still needs preparation for its destination.
svgai.seo.quality_text: A PNG describes pixels; an SVG describes vector geometry. Compare outline and color previews to locate stray fragments and overlapping paths. After unlocking, inspect the SVG code and simplify artwork for its display size. Test icon and logo contrast on light and dark backgrounds.
svgai.seo.prompt_title: Give the AI SVG generator a useful brief.
svgai.seo.prompt_text: Give the vector generator a subject, style, palette, and intended use. Specify a transparent background or no text when needed. “A blue orbital logo, flat vector shapes” gives clearer direction than unrelated styles. Change one prompt detail at a time and compare SVG results.

svgai.inner.guide.description: Learn how to prepare a prompt or image, refine SVG artwork, and export editable vectors with {brand}. Practical guidance for your first vector project.
svgai.inner.guide.heading: From your first point
svgai.inner.guide.subtitle: Learn how to turn a text prompt or an uploaded image into an editable SVG file, refine the result, and download it for your project.
svgai.inner.guide.start_text: Choose Text to SVG to create artwork from a written idea. Describe the subject, style, and palette, then generate a free preview without registering. Choose Image to SVG to convert an existing illustration, logo, or sketch. Select a clear PNG, JPG, or WebP image. Text and image modes share one free preview. Your browser resizes images before our server converts them; choose a plan to unlock the editable SVG file.
svgai.inner.guide.refine_text: Start with the preview to judge the composition. Then inspect the outline to see how the shapes are constructed. Change individual colors using the palette controls. For image conversion, try a smaller color count if the result feels noisy. Background removal is useful for a simple solid background, but always check the edges and any interior spaces afterward.
svgai.inner.guide.export_title: Take a standard SVG with you
svgai.inner.guide.export_text: Download the SVG file or copy its code. Keep an original version before making further edits in a vector editor. SVG code and React JSX are not identical; adapt attribute names and other details if you are building a React component. Before publishing, test the artwork at its intended size and confirm that its contrast, line weight, and visual detail suit the surrounding interface.
svgai.inner.guide.finish_text: A web icon, a printed poster, and a cutting file have different requirements. Confirm support for SVG in the destination application and inspect any imported shapes. For fabrication, check closed paths, overlaps, and minimum feature sizes. For brand work, review originality and rights. For websites, choose accessible alternative text that explains the image in its actual context.
